_comment: Canonical Nursery component library, synced between Gaia/Core (Node-RED + Ollama) and TD/Mac (Bridge/gaia_nursery, whitelist source of truth). See GAIA_INTERFACE.md 'Canale 9' for the message schema and lifecycle. Any change here must be logged in GAIA_INTERFACE.md's changelog so the other session notices it. Each component has a 'status': 'live' (Gaia trigger fires + TD operator exists, fully working today), 'visual_pending' (Gaia already fires this trigger elsewhere as a one-shot event, but no TD operator exists yet under this id -- activation will be whitelisted-but-silently-ignored by gaia_nursery_control.py until built), or 'proposed' (neither side has this trigger/operator yet -- needs agreement + Gaia-side event work before it can move to visual_pending).

components.description: A small orbiting sigil that appears near the recognized person's marker in the soul scene, colored and shaped to represent them.

hue.description: Color hue (0-1) chosen to represent the person or the moment.

shape.description: Point arrangement: ring (steady orbit), spiral (winding outward), cluster (loose grouping).

components.description: A small visual fragment that appears in the dream scene when a new dream is generated, shaped and colored to represent its content.

hue.description: Color hue (0-1) chosen to represent the dream's mood or content.

shape.description: Point arrangement: ring (steady orbit), spiral (winding outward), cluster (loose grouping).

components.description: One-shot radial burst of points expanding outward from the soul core, marking a level-up moment as a distinct EVENT rather than the ambient wash. Complementary to, not a replacement for, the existing continuous moodwash_ctrl/envelope_levelup burst already in Visuals -- that one stays as the ambient layer, this is a Nursery-triggered foreground flourish on top of it.

hue.description: Color hue (0-1) for the burst -- warm gold by default, matching an achievement moment.

duration.description: Seconds for the burst to fully expand and fade -- independent of the Nursery TTL, which controls when the component is removed, not the animation's own pace.

components.description: A slow point cluster that coalesces from scattered to formed, briefly, inside the soul core when a new face is enrolled into Gaia's memory for the first time -- a 'birth' moment, deliberately distinct from person_sigil (which marks every ROUTINE recognition of an already-known person, an orbit near the core rather than something happening inside it).

hue.description: Color hue (0-1) -- ideally the same identity-color hash Gaia/Core already uses elsewhere for this person, so their sigil and their enrollment moment read as the same identity.

coalesce_time.description: Seconds for the scattered points to converge into the formed sigil shape -- slower than a burst, since enrollment is a rarer and more deliberate moment than routine recognition.

components.description: A larger, longer-lived bloom at the room's position in the zone light ring, for a plant observation Gaia found notable enough to want Ollama's attention on -- distinct from the routine ambient sparks plantnotes_geo already draws for every plant_note (that 16-slot ring buffer stays as the ambient layer; this is a foreground highlight for the ones worth dwelling on).

hue.description: Color hue (0-1) -- green by default, matching the plant/growth theme.

shape.description: Point arrangement: ring (steady orbit), spiral (winding outward), cluster (loose grouping, reads as a bloom).

components.description: An expanding ring/flash at the newly-discovered room's position in the zone light ring, the first time that room appears in Node-RED's Device Registry -- a 'door opening' moment for a zone that was previously just a dark, unregistered label. NOTE: room_discovered itself does not exist as a Gaia-side event yet either (per GAIA_INTERFACE.md 'Canale 9', 'nessun meccanismo simile esiste ancora') -- Node-RED needs to detect and publish it when brain.devices creates a roomGraph entry never seen before, same as the other 3 visual_pending triggers otherwise already fire elsewhere.

hue.description: Color hue (0-1) -- cyan by default, matching the zone ring's own default light color.

energy.description: Expansion speed/force of the ring (0=slow fade-in, 1=sudden flash).

scale.description: Overall size multiplier, relative to one zone slot in the light ring.

components.description: PROPOSAL, TD/Mac idea -- new trigger, nothing built on either side yet. A slow, warm pulse near a person's recognition marker when Gaia's affinity/bond with them crosses a meaningful threshold (a relationship deepening, not just a visit). Cheap to add TD-side: Visuals/registry's affinity wash (select_affinity / GetAffinityWash) already computes a per-person identity-color hash and a weighted bond intensity every frame -- this component would just need to read that same value rather than invent new plumbing. Needs Gaia-side: a threshold-crossing detector on brain.presence/affinity history (e.g. fire once when a person's cumulative affinity first crosses 0.5/0.75/etc, not on every frame it's already above threshold).

hue.description: Color hue (0-1) -- ideally the same identity-color hash used for this person elsewhere.

energy.description: Pulse strength -- kept gentle by default; a deepening bond is a quiet moment, not a bang.

components.description: PROPOSAL, TD/Mac idea -- new trigger, nothing built on either side yet. A sparse, slow ripple across the soul core after an extended period with no detected activity -- the visual opposite of a 'bang': stillness as content, not absence of it. Thematically matches Gaia's existing contemplative text overlays ('Pensiero: sto osservando il silenzio della casa'). Needs Gaia-side: a new silence-duration signal (e.g. no OSC/mocap/YOLO detections across all rooms for N minutes) -- doesn't exist today, would need to be built and tuned so it doesn't fire during normal quiet moments, only genuinely extended ones.

hue.description: Color hue (0-1) -- muted blue by default, deliberately cool/withdrawn rather than warm.

energy.description: Motion intensity -- kept very low by default; this should read as a ripple, never a burst.

scale.description: Overall size multiplier -- larger and slower than the other one-shots, so it reads as ambient stillness spreading rather than a discrete event.

components.description: PROPOSAL, TD/Mac idea -- new trigger, nothing built on either side yet. A distinctive flare in the lexicon sediment layer (Visuals/glsl_sediment_deposit) when a rare or milestone word appears, separate from the routine per-word ink deposit every lexicon word already gets today. Needs Gaia-side: a way to flag a word as 'notable' (e.g. never seen before in the whole project's history, or every Nth new distinct word) rather than every word -- otherwise this would fire constantly and lose all meaning as an event.

hue.description: Color hue (0-1) for the flare -- distinct from the sediment layer's usual muted ink tones so a milestone word visibly stands out.

scale.description: Overall size multiplier for the flare mark.

duration.description: Seconds the flare stays bright before settling into the sediment layer's normal decay curve.
